title: どすこい！決まり手指導！？

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I see… So this is when you're supposed to use the thrust-down technique!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Exactly! When you're cornered at the edge of the ring, you can turn the tables by thrusting your opponent down and out! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A quick look at my surroundings confirms I'm in the cafeteria and not at a sumo match. So why am I hearing sumo terms coming from the kitchen?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer? Do you like cake?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm actually going to be baking cakes with Akebono after this, and I was hoping you could be my taste tester!
choice_data_list: Sure! I'd be glad to help.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yay! Thank you! Let's go, then!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Indeed, they're supposed to be making cakes, but for some reason…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, you need to whip the cream slower, like you're doing an arm locking twist down!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: An arm locking twist down, huh? Oh! It worked! The cream's formed soft peaks!
choice_data_list: (I've never seen anyone teach baking with sumo terminology before!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Phew… When frosting the sides, should I use the strength of a frontal push out?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: No, you can be bolder! You should use the strength of an inside leg trip! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Let's see, an inside leg trip… So it should be like whack! Wait, or was it more like a shwip?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hm… This will probably be easier to understand if I get a hands-on demonstration. Akebono, could you please show me the move?
choice_data_list: You're not going to start wrestling right here, are you?!
You're not going to start wrestling right here, are you?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Haha! No, no! Doing that in the kitchen would be dangerous!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: So let's head over to the gym!
choice_data_list: (It's not our location I'm worried about!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: First, please teach me the inside leg trip! Think of me as the frosting!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'll stop partway through the move so you don't get hurt, okay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Dosukoi!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I see! It's more like a whoosh! Next, can you show me how I should sprinkle on the chocolate with an over-thigh scooping body drop?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two continue on with their unique teaching techniques for a while…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff… The cake's finished! Phew! That was quite the workout.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Go ahead and give it a taste it right away, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I have my doubts about whether the method they used to bake this cake can really have been effective… It looks good, but how will it taste?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chomp…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To my surprise, the frosting has an incredibly delicate texture, and the sponge cake has the perfect amount of bounce to it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I had no idea it was possible to make such an exquisite cake!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yay! Our attempt to bake using nothing but winning sumo techniques was a grand success, Akebono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hooray! Sumo techniques really are something!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm not used to making Western desserts, but those moves helped me understand how much strength to use on each step! I bet they can be applied to other things too, like…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ooh, like training!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Maybe if we applied sumo techniques to training, I could improve faster! What do you think, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I'll buckle down and start memorizing them now!
Is there any trick to learning them?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: This may be a bit presumptuous of me, but since I have more experience in sumo wrestling than you, I'll be your teacher, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I learned from my dad how to be a sumo wrestler with real determination! First, you have to start at the bottom of the hierarchy…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And make a hot pot dish perfect for tired sumo wrestlers—chanko!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yay! Chanko!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, I put my nose to the grindstone and learn all about sumo through the power of chanko! I can't wait until I'm ready to use this in training!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: A trick? I guess doing some practice matches would be good! There's nothing like learning something through hands-on experience!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Let's head straight back to the gym, then! We can start by teaching you how to do a frontal thrust out…
choice_data_list: H-how about we watch a video of a match instead?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ooh, smart! It's good to get a firm understanding of the techniques before putting them into practice. I'll give you a running commentary on all the key points!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, I devote myself to studying sumo… though I think I'll do it at my own pace.
